title: Coordinate pollen forecast
scenario: Read the selected place's pollen from server1. The example was captured from a local server1 gateway using an isolated synthetic Tokyo response.

steps.title: Read the date and available species
steps.instruction: If the ordinary coordinate weather advertises pollenForecastAvailable, request the same coordinate path with /pollen-forecast. Read the region and date at the viewed location, along with source, credit and plant or pollen type codes.
steps.caption: A local Tokyo response with a date and Japanese cedar but no numeric index.
steps.expected: Keep the index missing when it is absent. Keep an explicit zero when provided. Preserve ordinary weather when the optional forecast is unavailable.
